verdicts.reason: The two candidates use the same weak leaderboard layout. In both, the four-line headline fills the strip, the body copy is a narrow, hard-to-read column, 'Ships late June' wraps into a ragged three-word stack, and the legal text is unreadably small at this height. The Reserve a Case button is also tiny and pushed into the top-right corner, where it competes with the legal block. In A the logo is broken: the sun icon has drifted to the right edge of the dark panel, away from a tiny 'SOLSTICE' wordmark. B keeps the sun centred above a larger, legible wordmark, so its brand mark survives better, though it is still cramped.
